DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY

Federal Energy Regulatory Commission

[Docket No. EL27-11-000]

Exelon Corporation v. PJM Interconnection, L.L.C.; Notice 
Establishing Comment Period

    On November 4, 2026, PJM Interconnection, L.L.C. (PJM) filed a 
preliminary answer opposing fast-track processing and a motion 
requesting a four-week extension of time, until December 21, 2026, to 
answer the complaint filed by Exelon Corporation (Exelon) in the above-
captioned proceeding. PJM argues that there is good cause to grant the 
extension because the additional time will permit PJM to incorporate 
into its response the outcome of the deliberations by the PJM Board, 
which will meet on November 17, 2026. PJM also argues that Exelon has 
failed to demonstrate any compelling reason for Commission action by 
the requested January 31, 2027, date and therefore a four-week 
extension of the answer deadline will not impair the Commission's 
ability to act.
    On November 9, 2026, Exelon filed a motion for leave to answer and 
answer. Exelon supports an extension of the comment period to December 
7, 2026, but argues that the scale of PJM's proposed extension is 
excessive for the narrow scope of the allegations it must answer. 
Exelon also urges the Commission to act sufficiently in advance of the 
May 2027 Base Residual Auction.
    Upon consideration, notice is hereby given that PJM's motion for 
extension of time is granted and the deadline to file the answer to 
Exelon's complaint, comments, and interventions is December 21, 2026.

(Authority: 16 U.S.C. 824e)

    Dated: November 13, 2026.
Carlos D. Clay,
Deputy Secretary.
